{{Cancer}}
Cancer 28 is the 224th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 28th day of Cancer, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 32, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 8宮28日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 224|Chapter 224]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152244}}.
